proposals.evidence: DEDR1041 attests Tamil/Malayalam ōṭu/ōṭuka and Kannada ōḍu run, with Tamil ōṭi- past/participial stem. Survey bare ōḍɨ/ōḍu/ōḍi and transparent ōḍinān/ōḍiyɛy finite forms retain that running root. Forms containing pō or another movement verb are excluded from this group. The paired elicitation gloss is retained even where this individual source record contains only the bare/imperative or inflected verb; no absent clause is reconstructed. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
